text:
asha: Quick sync — we need to lock the console observability roadmap slices for next quarter. Customers (AcmeHealth, FinLend) both call out: per-route cost breakdown + better trace hooks. I want a concrete must-have list + a minimal UX for launch. Can we decide today?

devon: I can own the tracing hooks work. Proposal: scoped hook points + a sampling config UI. Implementation plan: 2 infra tickets, 1 runtime change, 1 dashboard tile. Estimate: ~3 wks eng effort (sizable if we do full-span ingestion).

sam: Customer asks (short): 1) per-route cost by token + embedding calls, 2) trace-level error buckets (drop/retry/timeout), 3) simple rollup dashboard for ops. They will accept a phased rollout as long as we ship the cost attribution first.

leo: Flag — full-span tracing will spike telemetry costs. We should gate full-span and offer prefix/KV-cache only traces initially. Suggestion: default sampling=0.1, canary orgs at 1.0 for a week.

jen: From UX: we can surface a compact "cost by route" widget + an expandable detail pane with trace links. Mock attached in drive: https://redwood.internal/d/observe-mock (quick view). Need ownership for drilldown flows.

asha: Draft acceptance criteria (please react):
```
- Cost widget shows per-route token and embedding cost, grouped by day (7d window)
- Tracing hooks: server-side span annotation + linkable trace IDs in errors
- Sampling slider in Console that sets org-level sample rate and per-route overrides
- Rollout gates: canary on <5 orgs, error regression <2x baseline, latency P50 unchanged within 10%
- Regression tests: synthetic prompt set + CPU/GPU cost checks
```

devon: +1 for criteria. Need to add infra requirement: retention policy for traces (default 7 days) and a cheap aggregated storage path for cost metrics. I can add tickets: INF-1219, RUNTIME-4321.

leo: Also add alerting: if telemetry cost delta > 30% vs baseline for a given org, auto-disable full-span for that org. Ops should be able to opt-in.

asha: Good call. Who volunteers to own rollout playbook & SLA wording for Dedicated customers?

sam: I'll take rollout playbook + customer comms.

jen: I'll do the minimal UX screens and the drilldown acceptance flows.

devon: I'll scope infra + runtime work and post estimates by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Reminder: Weekly roadmaps sync at 15:00 PT.

asha: OK — decision for now: ship per-route cost widget + basic tracing hooks (annotated spans + trace IDs) as M1. Sampling UI + per-route overrides as M2, full-span gated by canary + alerts. If no objections by EOD, I'll mark this as the roadmap commit. :thumbsup:

leo: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup: will post tickets.

sam: :thumbsup:

jen: :thumbsup:

asha: Thanks all — I'll capture notes and owners in the roadmap doc after the sync.
